latestVersion.changelog:
Astro Transits v1.0.0

- Initial release of a comprehensive astrological transit calculator.
- Supports daily and weekly transits, including planetary positions, aspects to natal charts, Moon phases, stations, and ingresses.
- Detects void-of-course Moon periods and provides interpretations for active aspects.
- All calculations are local—no API key or external service required.
- Uses Swiss Ephemeris with Moshier fallback for high-accuracy results.
